description: This file declares the IpcLoop class, which manages an IPC communication loop using a thread, channels, and controller factories within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace. It provides methods for creating IPC channels, blocking closures, and RPC controllers, and maintains internal state related to IPC thread management.

classes.name: IpcLoop
classes.description: Manages an IPC communication loop with threading, channel, and controller factory management within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of IpcLoop with a socket and client reference.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the IPC channel used by this loop.

methods.name: createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a blocking closure for IPC operations.

methods.name: createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a gRPC RPC controller.

methods.name: ipcThread
methods.description: Internal method that runs the IPC thread loop.
